Singapore police investigate band's Palestinian flag display at concert

Singapore police are investigating the British band Massive Attack for displaying a Palestinian flag during a concert. Two band members received stern warnings and have been barred from returning to Singapore. Authorities also stated the band is excluded from performing in the country again. The incident occurred after the band unfurled the flag, which breached a ban on foreign emblems.
